notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hey Pong Fans! Yesterday we released an update for PONG Quest with the following changes:

[list]
[*] XP Tracker in the Quest Journal now shows the correct number instead of zero.
[*] Fixed a bug where pausing was not working when inside a challenge vortex.
[*] 2560 x 1440 screen resolution now supported in the options menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where elements may be cut off on some monitors with a "bleed" zone.
[*] Other minor stability fixes.
[/list]

Thanks for all your feedback so far, we're glad so many of you are enjoying the game.

Keep Paddlin'!

notes.title: Remember Pong? It's back, in RPG form
notes.content:
The creature wearing the skin of Atari have revisited perhaps the most iconic video game of the company whose bones it sucked clean of marrow then crunched to dust and swallowed, today releasing Pong Quest. It’s Pong, but also sort of a dungeon-crawler. I am sceptical of everything the creature wearing the skin of Atari does, especially after terrible decisions like rebooting Asteroids as a multiplayer survival game (since vanished), but new twists on old arcade games can turn out quite fun. HMMM. Observe, a trailer follows.
